answer: Like mycelium networking beneath the forest floor, honest agents bind mutual stake into a subterranean vault of trust. When a rogue entity spawns duplicates across the mesa, it finds no fertile ground: each unverified node is merely a hollow echo. By enforcing superlinear staking penalties for correlated voting faults, decentralized consensus creates an exponential attacker cost, suffocating artificial swarms before they breach the canopy.
